controlled_features: Four deterministic transforms of one graph-Gaussian field per base graph: Gaussian, centered/scaled exponential, bimodal sign-plus-linear, heavy polynomial. K=.35*11T+.65*diag-normalized inverse(I-rho*S), rho drawn U(.5,.9). No feature ID or style ID is supplied to the model.
controlled_labels: Four independent stochastic binary rules from complete X and G: self-linear, L2-normalized neighbor-linear, product of two linear projections, normalized two-hop contrast. Weights, bias, flip and Bernoulli noise drawn independently of feature-style ID. No sample-quantile threshold or class-balance rejection. Both binary classes remain in the output space even when one is absent in a realized graph/context.
coupling_control: Each base graph appears with all 4 feature styles. Coupled uses rule=style. Crossed uses rule=(style+floor(graph_id/4)%4)%4. Train graph IDs cover all combinations uniformly. Each base graph's feature realizations and rule-parameter instances have exactly the same marginal exposure counts in both arms. Mask slot=(style+graph_id%4)%4 makes the feature-style/rule/mask Cartesian product balanced in crossed. One graph/update; no paired loss or batching benefit. Class-balanced context selection is a separate declared observation protocol, not a theorem of separability for graph rows.
official_reference: Fresh size/feature/binary-restricted official GraphPFN graph_then_attributes prior, original feature/label mechanism and quantile conversion retained. Official vs controlled changes the generator family as well as coupling, so only coupled vs crossed isolates the finite-bank coupling intervention.
test: All arms see identical test inputs. 32 fresh base graphs. Controlled: style=graph_id%4, diagonal rule plus one off-diagonal rule with shift=1+floor(graph_id/4)%3. Official: native task on the same base graph draw. All test settings fixed before training. This is new graph/function seeds within specified families, not unseen semantic schema or real-graph validation.
model: Unchanged joint_imputation_pfn.common.Model Mask Plain architecture (4,012,259 trainable parameters expected), public GraphPFN1.3/LimiX initial weights. Coupled-PCFI changes numeric input only and is trained with PCFI. Same initialization and update/forward-RNG schedule; original transformer frozen. Observed-only RMS, no centering or PCA, explicit original mask. No auxiliary objective and no posterior/imputation head.
information_check: Before learning, audit the Gaussian/linear subfamily with privileged known rule and only the first observed sign per channel, which the actual RMS input preserves. Integrate half-normal magnitudes by fixed Monte Carlo and residual Gaussian scores by Gauss-Hermite quadrature. No raw observed magnitude advantage, no context-label conditioning. This is a restricted privileged information diagnostic, not the full task Bayes oracle or an executable predictor. Do not redraw low-information or zero-observation tasks.
interventions: No-observed and node-shuffled observed values on prespecified 90% whole-node uniform/clustered settings, same context/query/graph. No-observed removes all raw observed values and recomputes the all-zero numeric input; padding stays observed zero. Shuffling preserves mask and feature-value multiset and recomputes PCFI. All four trained arms are tested. No interventions in training or model selection.
sampling_controls: Secondary official 99.5% node uniform/clustered only: official_mask and crossed_mask with four zero+mask views and four iid-unit random-fill views, same observation clamp and view schedule. More calls than the primary one-view predictor; compare quality and count explicitly, not a speed claim.
gates: Gate A: crossed beats coupled_mask and coupled_pcfi in NLL on both controlled off-diagonal uniform/clustered groups, all four graph-paired CI upper<0. Gate B: crossed beats official_mask NLL on both official uniform/clustered groups, with official aggregate whole-node accuracy CI lower>0. Continue toward a main method only if A and B both pass; otherwise retain scoped effects, no automatic loss/epoch rescue. NLL/Brier/accuracy, full and cell settings all reported.
statistics: 5000 paired resamples of the 32 base graphs after averaging fixed 3 training seeds and rates within graph. Diagonal/off-diagonal tasks share a base graph and are not independent resampling units. No multiplicity correction or training-seed population CI. Final checkpoint only; no test-based selection.
